# CiteReady

CiteReady is an implementation pack, not a tracker.

Paste a URL. Get the files AI search can actually quote.

In 60 seconds: a spec-compliant llms.txt, FAQ schema, and citation-ready answers taken from your own page — plus the questions models cannot answer from your HTML.

We do not rank you in ChatGPT. We give you artifacts your developer can ship this afternoon.

## How it works

1. Paste a public URL.
2. We fetch the HTML. No login, no pixel, no store connect.
3. Download a zip. Paste the files into your CMS or head.
4. Optional later: $29 per month to recrawl weekly when schema drifted. Not in the first version.

## What is in the pack

- llms.txt and llms-full.txt — a curated index, not a sitemap dump
- FAQPage JSON-LD that matches visible content, with mismatch warnings
- 5–8 Q&As with on-page quotes. If it is not on the page, the field stays blank.
- gaps.md — claims a competitor can win because this page lacks numbers, dates, an author, or a one-sentence definition

## Pricing

- One-shot audit — $19 — one URL, zip by email, no account
- Starter — $29/mo — 5 URLs, weekly recrawl
- Agency — $79/mo — 25 URLs, white-label zip
- Studio — $149/mo — 75 URLs, team folder

Checkout today is the $19 one-shot only. Starter, Agency, and Studio are listed as upcoming plans. We do not collect a subscription in week one.
